fit.sheet: Mullard OC44 data sheet (Mullard Technical Handbook Vol. 4 Part III, Nov 1968: OC44 of Dec 1960, pages D1-D5 and C1-C6)
fit.figure: page C2 transfer characteristic at Vc = -2 V (IB 8.8 to 98 µA); page C1 IC against VBE at Vc = -2 V (0.11 to 10 mA); page D2 table (Ico); page D3 (rbb', Cb'c, fα, gce)
fit.method: see NOTES.md (germanium study): transfer, VBE-IC and Ico fitted together at Vc = -2 V, leakage included. Fitted points within 5.8 % (IC at IB) and 9.3 mV (VBE); ICBO 0.51 µA. Curves read off the raster by pixel (.claude/skills/fit-model/worked/germanium/pix.py)
fit.note: Provisional: a germanium-study card, not in the library (the AC128 stands in, D-170).
